title: Parallel Storyboard Continuity Lab
description: Stories, asset descriptions, model and aspect ratio stay fixed while spatial and continuity fields change. The quick set compares three stories, three variants and two critical shots per story in parallel.
missingProjectBody: Add a projectId query parameter. The lab uses that project's storyboard image model and the production billing and task pipeline.
variantsDescription: Baseline describes one frame; spatial adds topology and vantages; continuity adds instances, anchors and state transitions.

baseline.title: A Current baseline
baseline.description: Independent frame description without world topology, formal vantage or adjacent state.

spatial.title: B Spatial topology
spatial.description: Adds camera-independent topology, formal vantage, anchors and spatial invariants.

continuity.title: C Full continuity
continuity.description: Adds instance identity, reference roles, Before / Delta / After and key pose to the spatial protocol.

elevator.title: Elevator · Solo movement
elevator.description: Tests door, rear wall, control panel, floor display, entry, exit and button-press continuity.

restaurant.title: Restaurant · Two-person handoff
restaurant.description: Tests fixed seating, hand identity, single-prop ownership and occlusion by a passing third person.

warehouse.title: Warehouse · Multi-person chase
warehouse.description: Tests three people, vertical levels, fixed obstacles, occlusion, chase order and unique case ownership.
